risks.title: Purchases split to stay under the quote and tender threshold
risks.description: Payments to one supplier, each under the threshold, that together reach it within {{$.parameters.split_window_days}} days may indicate a requirement split to avoid the quote or tender route [rule:CPR-12].

likelihood.justification: {{$.tests.split_purchases.by_threshold[threshold=25000].by_tag.general_procurement.count}} general procurement groups reach the quote threshold of £{{$.named_thresholds.quote.value}} within the window [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.by_threshold[threshold=25000].by_tag.general_procurement.count]; at that value quotes from at least three sources are required [rule:CPR-52].

impact.justification: General procurement group totals of £{{$.tests.split_purchases.by_threshold[threshold=25000].by_tag.general_procurement.total}} may have sat outside the competition the rules require [rule:CPR-53] [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.by_threshold[threshold=25000].by_tag.general_procurement.total]: a reasonable possibility of successful challenge. Placement groups ({{$.tests.split_purchases.by_threshold[threshold=25000].by_tag.placement.count}}) are context only [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.by_threshold[threshold=25000].by_tag.placement.count].

risks.evidence: Full group list in outputs/analytics-full/split_purchases.csv. Contract Letting was last audited with Reasonable Assurance [history:AUD-01].
risks.proposed_focus: For the largest general procurement groups, establish whether the payments were one requirement and which quotes or tender were held.

risks.title: Spend after contract expiry
risks.description: Spend continuing after the matching notice ended, without an approved extension [rule:CPR-63].

likelihood.justification: Suppliers paid after their notice ended [rule:CPR-99] [metric:$.tests.expired_notice_scan.counts.suppliers].

noted_not_rated.reason: Direct Payments are excluded from every spend test before tagging, so no test measures this area [history:AUD-16].
